"İt" in Turkish means dog in a vulgar way and "İt" also used for to insult individuals. Even you don't say "İt" to dogs basicly it is not a kind word.

"İt" become popular after the TV show named "Kurtlar Vadisi" used mostly by character named "Abuzer [Köm]ürcü". When [Sir] Professor Abuzer wants to insult [his] son, he use that kind word.
